question_options.question: How would you rate this pack?
Did you expect Denni and Colt to kiss?
Have you ever been trapped somewhere?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: What do you think?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Yeah... That actually makes sense! I didn't know you were good at math!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: It was basic division, dude. I didn't exactly solve Fermat's Last Theorem.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Is that the biker bar on 9th street?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Hey, wait a minute... If Denni didn't bring anything to the table, why do we have to share with her at all?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: She figured out how to distribute the food, didn't she? That's good enough for me!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah, me too. I'll be totally honest, if Princess hadn't said something, I probably would've started stealing food and barricading myself in a desk fort!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Can we still make the desk fort?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: No.
Denni distributes the food among the four of them, and they sit around eating...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Mmmm! Great cookies!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: ...Thanks. This, uh, nutrition bar is pretty good too...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: And how about this tangerine, huh? Mmm-mmmmm!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Seriously, what is it with you and the tangerine?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I... I don't know, Denni. That math feels funny...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah, I flunked out of Trig twice, and `I` know it doesn't add up!
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, I flunked out of Trig twice, and [color=#e23b3b][i]I[/i][/color] know it doesn't add up!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: It seems good to me...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: That's because you end up with more food than anyone else!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: She just split it up, she didn't even say who gets what!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Not following.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Okay, okay, maybe we should all just take one item...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: But there's `three` items and `four` of us!
nodes.text_bbcode: But there's [color=#e23b3b][i]three[/i][/color] items and [color=#e23b3b][i]four[/i][/color] of us!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: And what's this `we` business? You didn't bring anything to the table! Why should we have to share with you at all?!
nodes.text_bbcode: And what's this [color=#3b78e2][i]we[/i][/color] business? You didn't bring anything to the table! Why should we have to share with you at all?!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Fine! No one share anything! See if I care!
Everyone sits in awkward silence.
Very slowly, Colt rips open his bag of cookies and pops one into his mouth. Taylor unwraps her nutrition bar. Brendan peels his tangerine.
Soon, the only sound is the gentle rumbling of Denni's stomach.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: 9 pieces...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: And we break the nutrition bar into...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: 10 cookies...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: And...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: 8 wedges...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Sooooo... What does everyone want to do when they get out of college?
Four hours since lockdown.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: And then I look down, and I'm totally naked in the middle of math class!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Hold on, I got distracted. Are we talking about worst nightmares or best dates?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Ooo, I've got a good question! What's everyone's favorite food?
As soon as Denni says the word 'food', everyone's stomach rumbles loudly!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Aw man, now you've got me thinking about a nice, big bacon burger...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Or a tres leches cupcake...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Or a tangerine!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I didn't really think about it until now, but... It `is` dinnertime. What are we gonna do about food? I mean, we're gonna need to eat...
nodes.text_bbcode: I didn't really think about it until now, but... It [color=#3b78e2][i]is[/i][/color] dinnertime. What are we gonna do about food? I mean, we're gonna need to eat...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Oh no. No no no. I've seen this movie before, and we are `not` resorting to cannibalism until we've been locked in at least ten hours...
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh no. No no no. I've seen this movie before, and we are [color=#e23b3b][i]not[/i][/color] resorting to cannibalism until we've been locked in at least ten hours...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Did anyone bring any food?
Colt sighs and reaches into his backpack. He takes a small pack of cookies out...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I have these. I was saving them for later. They're my sist... My favorite.
Taylor takes a nutrition bar out of her purse.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I've got this nutrition bar...
Brendan pulls a tangerine out of his back pocket.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: And my tangerine!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: ...Kinda weird, bro.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Well... It's not exactly a king's feast... But maybe it'll be enough to stave off the hunger...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah, well, I should get first dibs. I'm like three times the size of you guys!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You might be tall, but I have a very delicate metabolism! If I don't eat a full meal at the exact right time, it could throw my diet `completely` off!
nodes.text_bbcode: You might be tall, but I have a very delicate metabolism! If I don't eat a full meal at the exact right time, it could throw my diet [color=#3b78e2][i]completely[/i][/color] off!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Yeah, well, I'm already feeling kind of woozy... I think it might be the hunger...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Uh oh. This is going south, fast... There must be something I can do...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Hold on, guys. If we do this right, I bet we can distribute this stuff evenly...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Oh yeah? How?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Well, let's see. There's 20 cookies in the pack, and the tangerine has 8 wedges...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: So each of us should get...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Well... I... To be totally honest...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I've actually never been kissed.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: No way... Really?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Yeah, it's true...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Huh, that's... Kind of surprising actually. What happened, you never had the opportunity? Religious parents or something?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: No, I had the chance... There was this one party a year ago, where we played spin-the-bottle... But I pretended I was sick.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Maybe it's dumb, but I... I just want it to be special, you know? With someone I care about, and you know, in a way that means something...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Gosh... I must sound so corny, right?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: No, that's... Actually kind of sweet.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: And you've got a good point. I mean, as much fun as it was making out in Paris... Kat and I were really wrong for each other. We totally rushed things.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Yeah, I definitely rushed into mine too. I spent all night making out with Chuck after Homecoming... And a few days later, he was dating Katey, the head cheerleader!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: As for me, well... Let's just say having `one` girl mad at you is bad enough!
nodes.text_bbcode: As for me, well... Let's just say having [color=#e23b3b][i]one[/i][/color] girl mad at you is bad enough!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Honestly, don't feel embarrassed, Denni. I'm sure you'll have that special first kiss some day.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Awww... Thanks!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: My first kiss? Oh man, let me tell you about `my` first kiss...
nodes.text_bbcode: My first kiss? Oh man, let me tell you about [color=#3b78e2][i]my[/i][/color] first kiss...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: His name was... Uh... Zeph. Zeph... Awesome.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Cool name!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Eh.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: What was he like?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: He... Uh... Was the guitarist in this really popular rock band... He had green hair, a pierced eyebrow, and this sweet tattoo of a dragon.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Oooo, sounds hot! How'd you guys meet?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Well, uh... It was after one of his concerts... I was hanging out in the parking lot, and... Um...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: And he raced up on his environmentally-conscious sportscar! And he had this pet baby tiger in the back!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Oh! And he wanted to read some of my poems! And I was like, well, okay, if you insist, Zeph, and he was like, well, of course, beautiful, and...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Whoa, whoa, stop right there. Zeph Awesome? Tattooed rock star? Sportscar? `Read your poems?`
nodes.text_bbcode: Whoa, whoa, stop right there. Zeph Awesome? Tattooed rock star? Sportscar? [color=#e23b3b][i]Read your poems?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Either you're full of it, or my lie-dar is way off...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Okay, okay, you got me. I'm making it up.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I was `wondering` why I'd never heard of him!
nodes.text_bbcode: I was [color=#3b78e2][i]wondering[/i][/color] why I'd never heard of him!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: The truth is... I've never had a first kiss.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Really? That's hard to believe. I know there are so many rock stars out there just dying to read a high school girl's poetry...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: It's not that. It's just... I want it to be special, you know? With someone I care about, and you know, in a way that means something...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Well, don't worry, ugly duckling, one day your prince will come... And maybe you won't have to lie about fake kisses!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Aww... I think it's cute...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: No! Don't reward her! She made up a rock star!
Colt slumps back down onto the floor.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Guess we're stuck here, huh?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Well? What are we supposed to do? Talk?
Three hours since lockdown.
The four sit around in a circle, having shifted the desks together.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: And that's the true story of my first kiss.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: That is `incredible!` You made out with `both` of them?
nodes.text_bbcode: That is [color=#e23b3b][i]incredible![/i][/color] You made out with [color=#e23b3b][i]both[/i][/color] of them?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What can I say? Freshman year was good times.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Anyway. Your turn, Dorktopus. What was your first kiss like?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Let me guess... The two of you sitting in front of a pair of laptops... The only sound the distant clanking of swords... 'I'll be your high score, baby', you say with a grin...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I'll have you know, my first kiss was `very` romantic! It happened in Paris, in fact...
nodes.text_bbcode: I'll have you know, my first kiss was [color=#e23b3b][i]very[/i][/color] romantic! It happened in Paris, in fact...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Really?
Two years ago, in a hotel room in Paris, Brendan and Kat sit on a bed...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Now, I really like you, but this `is` my first relationship, and I'd like to take it slow...
nodes.text_bbcode: Now, I really like you, but this [color=#e23b3b][i]is[/i][/color] my first relationship, and I'd like to take it slow...

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: Yeah, yeah, blah blah. Wanna make out?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Yes!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Yep. Super romantic.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: How about you, Taylor? What was your first kiss like?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Honestly? It was incredible. I was a naive freshman cheerleader... He was the captain of the football team... And we'd just won the Homecoming Game!
Two years ago, on the Centerscore Football field, Taylor stands by the side of the field...

nodes.speaker: Chuck
nodes.text: Well, hey there, good looking.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Oh! Hi! Awesome football captain guy! You did great when you thraw the bool! Threw the ball! When you threw the ball!

nodes.speaker: Chuck
nodes.text: I saw you cheering at half-time... That was great! Even if you were at the bottom of the pyramid...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Yeah, well, you know, I'm, uh, new, but, uh, one day, I'd like to be, you know, in the middle. Ha ha! Right? Ha ha!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Oh no. Am I doing that thing where I laugh nervously?
Chuck leans forward.

nodes.speaker: Chuck
nodes.text: Just a little. And you know, you don't have to be so nervous. I just wanted to say hi...
Taylor leans up...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Is that... Is that all?
Chuck leans forward even more, so that their noses are touching...

nodes.speaker: Chuck
nodes.text: Well, maybe not all...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: All right, all right! We don't need a play-by-play...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Oh really? That didn't stop you from giving us all the details about the Hoffman Twins!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Wow, Taylor! I can't believe you were so nervous back then! That's hard to imagine!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Yeah, well, we all change, right? How about you? What was your first kiss like?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Oh no! The truth is... I've never `had` a first kiss!
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh no! The truth is... I've never [color=#3b78e2][i]had[/i][/color] a first kiss!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: But if I admit that, they'll think I'm totally lame! Even Brendan's had a kiss! What do I do?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Colt! Wait!
Colt freezes mid-swing, the desk just inches from the window!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: `What?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]What?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I don't want to ruin what could prove to be the highlight of an otherwise bleak day...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: But if Principal Dyre's taken the effort to block out phone signals, don't you think he bothered to reinforce the windows?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: That...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Is a really good point. Nerd Herder, anything you can tell me about this glass?
Brendan walks over and taps the glass a few times with his knuckles...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Yep. This is reinforced glass. A bullet couldn't punch a hole through this stuff.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Really? You can tell that just by tapping it?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: What? No, it says so right here.
Brendan points to a sticker on the top of the window: 'McGraw's Reinforced Glass. A bullet couldn't punch a hole through this stuff!'

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Well, I guess it's a good thing you stopped me, tiny hipster. I might've hurt myself!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: A big tough guy like you? No way...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Ha ha.
Colt slams the desk into the window... And it holds strong, barely buckling!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Oh come on! What is this, super-glass?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Well, Dyre did say this was the ultimate lockdown system. It wouldn't be all that good if we could just break through the windows...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah, well, I'll show him!
Colt winds up and smashes it again! The window holds strong!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: `Graaahhhh!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Graaahhhh![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Colt winds up once more, but this time the desk shatters against the window! Shards go flying everywhere! One bounces off Brendan's glasses!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Gah!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Huff... Huff...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: That was... `So hot!`
nodes.text_bbcode: That was... [color=#3b78e2][i]So hot![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Hot?! He could have blinded me!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah, well, it was useless... We're still trapped here...
Colt looks down.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: `And` I tore a hole in my favorite shirt!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]And[/i][/color] I tore a hole in my favorite shirt!

nodes.text: Two hours since lockdown.
The four sit sprawled around the room. Colt rests across the teacher's desk. Taylor sits on the floor. Brendan paces nervously in the corner.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: The other girls are all on the bus right now... Probably arguing over who gets to be on the top of the pyramid... Insulting each other's hair... Fighting for attention...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I'm so upset I'm not with them!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah, well, we've all got places to be, sweetheart.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Oh yeah? Is there an illegal bike race down at the shady dockyard?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I can't tell if you're making fun of me or just being really awkward.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: My money's on both.
Suddenly, Brendan freezes mid-pace.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Guys... Guys! What if Dyre's not coming back?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What are you talking about? Of course he's coming back! How could he not be coming back?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I mean... He's already two hours late! What if he... Forgot about us?
A tense, stunned silence fills the room...
Which Colt breaks by pounding savagely on the door!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Let us out! Let us `out!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Let us out! Let us [color=#e23b3b][i]out![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I can't believe it. I'm going to miss the game `and` the after-party!
nodes.text_bbcode: I can't believe it. I'm going to miss the game [color=#3b78e2][i]and[/i][/color] the after-party!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Relax! It's not that bad! The door opens from the outside, right? So as soon as someone comes looking for one of us, we'll be let out!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Well, no one's going to come looking for me! I told my parents I'd be at the game, and all my friends are at...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah, the big game, you mentioned that a couple times. How about you, Dorklahoma? Shouldn't your parents come looking for you?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I told my parents I'd be sleeping over at Dex's... See, there's this new game out, Chainsaw Chimp, and we were going to marathon through it...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Slow down. Chainsaw Chimp? What could that possibly be about?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: It's a chimp with a chainsaw!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Walked into that one. My point is, shouldn't Dex come looking for you?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Let me repeat myself... `Chimp with a chainsaw.` I could be running around on fire, and he probably wouldn't put down the controller.
nodes.text_bbcode: Let me repeat myself... [color=#e23b3b][i]Chimp with a chainsaw.[/i][/color] I could be running around on fire, and he probably wouldn't put down the controller.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Well, I won't have anyone looking for me. My mom's on a business trip, so I'm on my own this week...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Great. Tell me about it.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Your parents won't come for you?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: My dad probably won't notice I'm gone for days. Heck, the only person that would come looking for me is busy taking control of the cheerleading team...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: `Hey!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Hey![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: So... We're stuck here.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Not if I have anything to say about it!
Before anyone can move, Colt grabs a desk and winds up to smash it into the window!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: That's easy for you to say! You're not the one missing a chance to cheerlead at the biggest game of the year!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You might be fine sitting in here knitting or stitching or whatever old lady craft is ironically `in` this month... But some of us have lives!
nodes.text_bbcode: You might be fine sitting in here knitting or stitching or whatever old lady craft is ironically [color=#3b78e2][i]in[/i][/color] this month... But some of us have lives!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Hey! I have a social life! Just because I wasn't voted Queen of Hearts...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Oh, wait! You weren't either!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Snap! Ten points to Princess!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Don't you get involved in this! You probably set this all up so your stupid, little girlfriend could take over the squad!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What? How could I have possibly done that?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Oh, I don't know! Maybe you collaborated with your best friend, Principal Dyre!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Hey, I am many things, but I am `not` friends with that mean, old...
nodes.text_bbcode: Hey, I am many things, but I am [color=#e23b3b][i]not[/i][/color] friends with that mean, old...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Guys, seriously, we shouldn't fight...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Shut it, brain patrol! If you can't hackify the ENT matrix to let us triangulate our phones, what good are you?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Those... Those are just words...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Look... If we can't get along... Then let's all just quietly sit down and wait for Principal Dyre to let us out!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Fine!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Sure!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Whatever.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Well, that didn't go well...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: At least it can't be that much longer until Dyre comes to let us out...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: ...Can it?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I'm no scientist, but I'm pretty sure that won't work...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Actually... There's a chance it might!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Wait, really?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: It's unlikely... But if we all dial the same number at the exact same time... It's possible the signals will consolidate into one super signal that might just burst through!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: All I heard was blah blah blah signal, blah blah blah get out of this stupid room.... But that's good enough for me.
A few minutes later, all four students have their phones out and Sam's phone number punched in.
All four press 'Send!'
Nothing happens.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Dang! Didn't work!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Well... It was a good effort, I guess.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah, I really thought it might get us out for a second there.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I'm pretty sure Brendan's technobabble `was` gibberish... But focusing all four of us on a single task really helped diffuse the tension!
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm pretty sure Brendan's technobabble [color=#3b78e2][i]was[/i][/color] gibberish... But focusing all four of us on a single task really helped diffuse the tension!

nodes.text: Denni glances over at Brendan. He shoots her a knowing wink.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Well, we're fine for now. And it can't be that much longer until Dyre comes to let us out...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: ...Can it?
Principal Dyre steps away.

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: Ahem. It's 2:45 now. I'll come back in 45 minutes at 3:30 to let you four out. Until then, you will sit here and work quietly on your homework.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Wait, are you sure this is...
Dyre steps out of the room and presses a button on the wall.
The door slams shut, and steel bolts spring through the hinges. Solid metal latches click shut on the windows. The only sound is the dull hum of the air vent.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Well... This sucks.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: So... What do we do now?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: There's no teacher here, right? So we do whatever we want!
One hour since lockdown.
The four students sit at their desks in silence. Taylor taps her foot as she listens to her MP3 player. Brendan plays 'Cause of Death' on his cell phone. Colt rests his head in his hands.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: So, uh, guys? I don't want to distract you from your, uh, activities... But wasn't Principal Dyre supposed to let us out fifteen minutes ago?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Great. Typical Dyre. I bet he thinks it's funny to make us sit in here and wait. That dude has some serious issues...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Yeah, well, I'll show him some real issues if I end up missing the game! The cheerleader's bus leaves in 10 minutes. I'll just give them a quick call...
Taylor takes out her phone and dials a number.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Oh, `lame!` No reception! But I always have service on campus...
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh, [color=#3b78e2][i]lame![/i][/color] No reception! But I always have service on campus...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Hmm... I'm not getting any either... And I think I know why!
Brendan walks up to the door and traces a thin silver tube up to the ceiling.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Yep, just like I thought. We're in some kind of Faraday cage.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: In human terms, nerdbot?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: The walls have been reinforced with a conductive mesh that blocks any external electric fields.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I said `human terms!`
nodes.text_bbcode: I said [color=#3b78e2][i]human terms![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: While we're in lockdown, no signals are going in or out of this room. No phone... No internet...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: If only I had my old ham radio...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Why do I have a feeling that's neither as useful nor as delicious as it sounds?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Look, the Principal can't just lock us in here and not let us call anyone! That's, like, got to be against the Geneva Convention...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I'm pretty sure that's for prisoners of war...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Well, what do you call `us?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, what do you call [color=#3b78e2][i]us?![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Colt punches his desk!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Unbelievable. This is just `unbelievable!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Unbelievable. This is just [color=#e23b3b][i]unbelievable![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I have places to be, people to take care of...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: People to take care of?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Just... Unbelievable!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: `You're` unbelievable! If it wasn't for you, Principal Dyre wouldn't have even invented this stupid system!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]You're[/i][/color] unbelievable! If it wasn't for you, Principal Dyre wouldn't have even invented this stupid system!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Oh, sure, blame it on me!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: This is getting really heated! I need to do something!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Everyone, let's all just...

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: Oh really? And who do you think sets school policy?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Well, I... I mean, you do, technically, but you have to report to a superintendent, right? Or like, a board...
Principal Dyre crosses the room and slams his fist on Denni's desk!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Agh!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Hey man, that's not cool...

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: Let me tell you something, you mop-haired moppet. I am the `greatest` Principal this state has ever seen. I have taken schools that were crime-ridden dumps and turned them into top-tier prep academies!
nodes.text_bbcode: Let me tell you something, you mop-haired moppet. I am the [color=#e23b3b][i]greatest[/i][/color] Principal this state has ever seen. I have taken schools that were crime-ridden dumps and turned them into top-tier prep academies!

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: The superintendent does what `I` tell him to! The PTA board does what `I` tell them to!
nodes.text_bbcode: The superintendent does what [color=#e23b3b][i]I[/i][/color] tell him to! The PTA board does what [color=#e23b3b][i]I[/i][/color] tell them to!

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: Want to raise it a level further? I've got two state senators on speed dial.

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: Are we perfectly clear?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: ...Yes, sir.

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: Good!

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: ...Go on.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Well, I just mean... Are we really the best group of people to stress-test a detention-escape security system?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I've never even been to detention before, and neither has Brendan...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: And while I'm sure Taylor has seen the inside of these walls before, I can't imagine her breaking a nail, much less breaking out of detention.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Nice wordplay...

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: Well... I will admit, you do have something of a point. You three little minnows wouldn't do much to test the resistance of my net...
Dyre walks over to Colt's desk.

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: Luckily, you've got the biggest trout in the pond in your midst! And he'll give me all the fight I need!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I'm sorry, did I miss something? When did we start talking in fishing metaphors?
Denni and Taylor scale their way up the desks...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Steady... Steady... Take it slow and steady...
Denni puts one foot on a desk, grabs the leg of another, and very carefully pulls herself up to the top!
Taylor pulls herself up next to Denni!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Nice climbing skills!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Thanks!
Taylor reaches up towards the vent, but can't quite reach it...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Hold me by my waist, would you? That way, I can lean out and grab it...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Okay... I'll do my best...
Denni puts her arms around Taylor's waist. Taylor leans forward and touches the grate of the air vent...
When a metallic voice blasts out of a speaker! `'SECURITY BREACH! ATTEMPTED ESCAPE VIA AIR VENTS!'`
nodes.text_bbcode: When a metallic voice blasts out of a speaker! [b]'SECURITY BREACH! ATTEMPTED ESCAPE VIA AIR VENTS!'[/b]

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: That's not good...
`'ACTIVATING SECURITY COUNTERMEASURE!'`
nodes.text_bbcode: [b]'ACTIVATING SECURITY COUNTERMEASURE!'[/b]

nodes.text: The grate buzzes with a blast of static electricity!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Ouch!
Taylor hurls herself back, slipping off the desk! She pulls Denni down with her!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah, well, my dad always had a good excuse too.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: 'Oh, I got stuck working late at the plant'... 'I got lost on the way to your school'... 'My car broke down, and I didn't have bus fare'...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: But...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: It doesn't matter how good the excuse is. All that matters is that there's a lonely kid in a dark room staring at a ticking clock, waiting for someone who's not there.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Colt...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Forget it, all right? Just forget it. You wouldn't understand.
Denni turns away. Everyone sits in silence while the fire slowly burns.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Sooooo... What's everyone's favorite scary movie?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Not now, Brendan.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Sorry.
Colt lunges out of his seat, kicking a chair over!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah? And what makes me a good person? I'm letting an eight-year-old girl down!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Good people make mistakes, Colt. But you love your sister. You care about her. And she `knows` that.
nodes.text_bbcode: Good people make mistakes, Colt. But you love your sister. You care about her. And she [color=#3b78e2][i]knows[/i][/color] that.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: She knows you're nothing like your dad.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: And what makes you so sure? How do you know what she knows?
Denni steps forward and places a hand on Colt's shoulder.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Because `I` can tell you're a good person, Colt.
nodes.text_bbcode: Because [color=#3b78e2][i]I[/i][/color] can tell you're a good person, Colt.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Under all the anger and sarcasm and nicknames... There's a good heart beating.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: And if I can tell that after having been locked with you for seven hours... I guarantee you that your sister can tell too. After all, she's known you all her life.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: ...Thanks, Denni. That means something.
Colt pats your hand for one moment, then turns away.
At the other end of the room, Brendan and Taylor stare at each other.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Was it just me, or did that get `super` heavy?
nodes.text_bbcode: Was it just me, or did that get [color=#e23b3b][i]super[/i][/color] heavy?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Seriously!
Just then, there's the crackle of a distant generator...
And the lights go off. The room is bathed in darkness.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Oh no. Oh no. This is bad. Dark is bad.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What are you, nine? Just sit tight. I'll figure something out...
Seven hours since lockdown.
The group sits huddled in a circle. A fire burns in a trashcan in the middle of the room...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: This is... Actually pretty nice. I feel like I'm stranded on a harsh, alien planet, and I've made a fire out of bioluminescent alien vines...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I would've gone with 'sitting by a fireplace'...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Where'd you learn how to build a fire, Colt?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: That? I just shoved a bunch of old papers in a trashcan and used my lighter...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Yeah... But you referred to the papers as 'kindling'...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Well... If you have to know... My dad taught me how to do it when we went camping.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: We only went when I was eight. He'd just gotten fired from his job at Prince Automotive, and decided to take me out to the woods.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: He showed me how to set up a tent... Catch a fish... And yeah, how to build a fire.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: It's weird, I don't have a lot of good memories from being a kid... But I swear, I can remember every second of that camping trip.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: He promised me we'd do it every year... Said it'd be a new beginning for the two of us...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: We never went again. These days, I don't think he even remembers the trip.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Colt...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Naw, don't... Don't do that. Don't give me the pity eyes. I'm fine. I'm all right. I don't need a camping trip to know my place in the world.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: It's my little sister I'm worried about. She's the one that's still vulnerable... The one who can still be disappointed.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Is that what you were supposed to do tonight? Spend some time with her?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah. I was gonna make dinner for her tonight... Instead, she's probably sitting alone in my dad's apartment.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I let her down... I'm just like my dad.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Colt, you're wrong. You're nothing like him.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah? And why's that?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Because...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I have to say, Taylor, I'm a little surprised by you...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: What do you mean?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I just thought you'd be a little bit tougher. I figured, you know, being head cheerleader, you'd have suffered all kinds of injury...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Well... It's true, there was that time we practiced for nine hours straight, and I severely strained both hamstrings...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: And that time when I was a freshman and the whole pyramid fell on top of me...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: And that time Adam rushed off the field and tackled me by accident! I was on crutches for a week!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: See? You're way too tough to care about a bruised arm!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You... You're right! What kind of an example would I set to the other cheerleaders if I let this get me down?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Exactly!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: If they ever found out about this, they would totally stop respecting me! I bet they'd even demand breaks to hydrate!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: That's... Probably something you should let them have...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: But I'm glad you've cheered up!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Yeah... Thanks, Denni. You're... You're all right.
Denni moves back to her chair. Colt shoots her an appreciative nod.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: So... You got any guys in your life?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: No, thanks for asking! I'm single! Like a loser!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I'm single...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I cut things off with that Bryce guy, and I didn't hook up with anyone during Spring Break, and Chuck started dating Katey, and...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Okay, okay, maybe this was the wrong course of conversation...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Now my arm is broken, and they're going to have to cut it off, and who's going to want to date a girl with one arm?!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: ...And we're back to the Middle Ages.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: My life is over! `Over!` Waggggggggh!
nodes.text_bbcode: My life is over! [color=#3b78e2][i]Over![/i][/color] Waggggggggh!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I'm, uh, just going to sit over there now.
Denni moves away from Taylor and sits down at the far end of the room. Colt shoots her an angry glare.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: ...Sorry.
Denni and Taylor scale their way up the desks...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Steady... Steady... Take it slow and steady...
Taylor neatly bounds past Denni, getting to the very top of the pile!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Come on, slowpoke! We don't have all day!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I'm trying, but I'm not that good at this!
Denni pulls herself up so she's almost at Taylor's level...
Just then, the desk she's holding onto wobbles!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Oh no!
She struggles to hold on, but the desk slides out! Both she and Taylor plummet!
Five hours since lockdown.
Taylor is doing Denni's hair. Brendan is back to his cell phone. Colt lies on the floor, his eyes wide open.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Yawwwwn.
Suddenly, Colt lunges up off the floor!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Okay! That does it!

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: Gah! That was loud!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Can it, Sleepy. We're busting out of this room, and we're doing it `now.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Can it, Sleepy. We're busting out of this room, and we're doing it [color=#e23b3b][i]now.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: This again? Didn't you learn your lesson with the refortressed glass?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: So? The first time Columbus tried to sail the world, he accidentally ended up in India. But that didn't stop him from trying to find America!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: That's... Wrong on so many levels.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Why the sudden urgency, Colt?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Because it's getting late, and people are getting tired, and some people should already be in bed and... It doesn't matter, okay? We're busting out of here, and that's that!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: How do you plan to do that?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Well... There has to be `some` way in and out, right? I mean, how do the guys escape in those movies about prison breaks?
nodes.text_bbcode: Well... There has to be [color=#e23b3b][i]some[/i][/color] way in and out, right? I mean, how do the guys escape in those movies about prison breaks?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I don't know... They usually steal the guard's keys...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Not relevant.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Or escape through the sewer pipe...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Not sanitary.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Or crawl out through the air vents...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Not...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Wait a minute! Why `don't` we do that?
nodes.text_bbcode: Wait a minute! Why [color=#3b78e2][i]don't[/i][/color] we do that?

nodes.text: All four look up at the ceiling... Where the grated vents hum with the flow of air.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: That's it! That's our ticket out of here!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: But how do we get... Up there?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: If we stack a few of the desks on top of each other, we should be able to reach it!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I don't know... That doesn't seem very stable... What if we fall?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Um, hello? I'm the head cheerleader! I'm used to being on top of shifting, unstable piles!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I'm too big to fit in that vent anyway. Why don't Brendan and I stand at the bottom and stabilize the desks, and you two ladies climb to the top and open the vent?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Well... It's worth a shot.
Colt and Brendan grab some desks. Within a few minutes, there are four desks stacked up to the ceiling. They teeter slightly.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You ready to climb, Denni?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Ready as I'll ever be...
Denni steps forward towards the stack of desks...
Imagine breaking out of the classroom, but still being stuck in the school! That would suck, right?
That's like coming this close to a perfect ending! Try again!
Denni tries to pull herself forward...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Come on, Denni... You've got this...
She crawls forward in the darkness, rounds a corner...
And suddenly feels a sharp pain in her leg, just above the ankle!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: `Agggh!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Agggh![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What is it?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: My leg! I think my leg is caught in something! It really hurts!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Hold on! I'm turning around!
Denni struggles to get free, but that makes it worse!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Colt, it really hurts! I think it's cutting me!
Colt squeezes back and pulls alongside Denni. He reaches back and feels for Denni's leg...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Looks like it's a loose piece of copper wiring... Your leg got snagged in it, and it's scraping against your skin...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Let me just untangle it...
Colt reaches down and pulls the wiring back... And there's a hot electrical zap!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: `Ow!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Ow![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: You okay?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah, it just shocked the heck out of my hand...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You thinking what I'm thinking?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: This is `way` too dangerous?
nodes.text_bbcode: This is [color=#3b78e2][i]way[/i][/color] too dangerous?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah. I'm all down for being a daredevil... But there is no way I'm dying underneath my high school.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Let's head back.
A few minutes later, Denni and Colt emerge back from beneath the floor.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: What happened to your leg? What happened to his hand? You two couldn't find a way out?
Colt slides the floor panel back into place.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: It's not gonna happen, man. Sorry.
Denni and Colt crawl together through the darkness! They round a tight corner, squeeze between two pipes...
And find themselves in a dead end!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: No! `No!`
nodes.text_bbcode: No! [color=#e23b3b][i]No![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I `swear` I saw a light around here...
nodes.text_bbcode: I [color=#e23b3b][i]swear[/i][/color] I saw a light around here...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Colt... Maybe you did.
Colt slowly looks up... And sees a thin ray of moonlight shining down through a crack in the ceiling of the tunnel!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Holy... Jackpot! Kick! Kick now!
Colt and Denni kick up as hard as they can! The top of the tunnel cracks open, and reveals...
The cafeteria!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yes! Freedom! We're free!
Colt pulls himself out, reaches down, and helps Denni up!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I never thought I'd be this happy to see the school cafeteria!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: We made it! We `really` made it!
nodes.text_bbcode: We made it! We [color=#e23b3b][i]really[/i][/color] made it!

nodes.text: Colt grabs Denni and hugs her close!
Then the two stop... Pull away...
Then step back together in a passionate kiss! Colt cradles Denni close! She wraps her arms around his back!
Bathed in warm moonlight, the two kiss for one endless minute... Then pull away.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: ...Wow.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah. I... Also, the...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: And you... You have a girlfriend... And...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I... I should go let Brendan and Taylor out.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: No... Let me. You need to go to your sister.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: ...You sure?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Yeah. Totally. Get out of here. I'll take care of Brendan and Taylor.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Thanks! You're... You're the best.
The two step together, as if they were about to hug again, then quickly change their minds. Colt runs off. Denni stands alone.
Later that night, in the Centerscore Parking Lot, the bus carrying the cheerleaders pulls up to the school. The cheerleading team files out...
And they find Taylor waiting for them!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Taylor! There you are! You totally missed the big game!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: How'd we do?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It was great! Centerscore totally won, and we did this great pyramid, and...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh no... Are you mad that we did it without you?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: No. not at all. I'm just happy you girls had a good time...
And in Brendan's room, Dex paces excitedly back and forth...

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: And then, and then, the boss is this Gorilla with a Gatling gun, so you have to circle-strafe him while throwing stink-bombs...

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Oh! And then, when you kill him, it turns out he's actually Chainsaw Chimp's brother!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: And don't get me started on what that does to my Chainsaw Chimp meta-timeline...
On the other side of the room, Brendan lies in his bed, blissfully asleep.
And meanwhile, outside a small apartment building, Colt knocks on a door...
It swings open, and Madeline flies out, wrapping her arms around Colt's neck!

nodes.speaker: Madeline
nodes.text: Colt! You made it!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah... Yeah, I did. Sorry I'm late.

nodes.speaker: Madeline
nodes.text: It's okay! I watched TV and ate cookies!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Why does that not surprise me?

nodes.speaker: Madeline
nodes.text: Where were you?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You wouldn't believe me if I told you...
And finally... In Denni's room... She sits by her window... And presses one hand to her lips!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Wow!
Well! Who would've expected `that` ending?
nodes.text_bbcode: Well! Who would've expected [b]that[/b] ending?

nodes.text: Denni broke out of detention... AND had a magical first kiss! Great job!
Eight hours since lockdown.
All four students lay on the ground, their heads together, staring up.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: So we're stuck here overnight, huh?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Looks like it.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: At least someone'll find us tomorrow, right?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You sure about that? Tomorrow's Saturday. No one's going to be at school...
Brendan sighs deeply.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: You want to know something funny? I don't even care about Chainsaw Chimp any more. I just want to get out of here, go to my house, and flop down in my bed.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You're telling me... Right now, the only thing I want to do is see my team again. I don't even want to yell at them or make them lose weight... Just see their faces.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah, well, you know what I'm going to do the second the door opens? I'm going to find Principal Dyre... And I'm going to take him `down!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, well, you know what I'm going to do the second the door opens? I'm going to find Principal Dyre... And I'm going to take him [color=#e23b3b][i]down![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Suddenly, Brendan shoots upright!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: That's... That's it!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Huh? What's it?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: What you just said! `Down!` That's the key!
nodes.text_bbcode: What you just said! [color=#e23b3b][i]Down![/i][/color] That's the key!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: We've tried escaping `up...` But we haven't tried going `down!`
nodes.text_bbcode: We've tried escaping [color=#e23b3b][i]up...[/i][/color] But we haven't tried going [color=#e23b3b][i]down![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: What are you talking about?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: There's a series of underground crawlspaces that run beneath the entire school! They use them to run the cables and the plumbing!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: If we could break open the floor, we could crawl through them and escape!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You beautiful, little dork! I could kiss you!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I'd pay to see that.
Colt lunges up and grabs a desk! He smashes it against the floor!
The tile cracks open! Brendan, Denni and Colt pull up the floor... And reveal a tight, dark passageway, packed with wires and dirty pipes!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Nice. You sure that leads out?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Definitely!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Can you lead us through it?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Nope!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Okay, okay. So we'll all just squeeze in and crawl until we see a way out...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I... I can't.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What are you talking about?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: My arm hurts too much! There's no way I can use it to pull myself through the tunnel!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I'll stay behind. You guys go on, then come back for me!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I'll... I'll stay with you.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: What? Why?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: What if we get out, and then can't figure out a way to open the doors? What if something goes wrong?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: You'd be stuck here, all alone in the night... And I can't let that happen.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You'd stay? For me?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Sure! What are friends for, right?
Taylor sits up and takes Brendan's hand.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Thank you. Seriously.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: All right, Princess. Looks like it's down to you and me. Stick close together, and holler out if anything goes wrong!
Colt vanishes into the crawlspace.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Okay... Let's do this!
Denni takes a deep breath... And then pulls herself down into the floor!
The crawlspace is narrow and pitch black! Denni pulls herself along, reaches out, and grabs Colt's foot!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: That you, tiny hipster?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Yep,  it's me... This tunnel is really tight...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You're telling me...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Hey! I think I might see some light up ahead! If we keep crawling, we might be able to reach it!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Then what are we waiting for? Let's crawl!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: That's the spirit!
Soon enough, the four grow tired. Brendan is the first to fall asleep, then Taylor, then Denni. Colt watches over the others for some time, then drifts off to sleep.
The next morning. One by one, they wake up...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: No... We're still here? I was sure this was just a terrible dream...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yup... We're still here. And all the doors are still locked. I checked.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: But that... That can't be! How is that possible? `Someone` must have come to look for us!
nodes.text_bbcode: But that... That can't be! How is that possible? [color=#3b78e2][i]Someone[/i][/color] must have come to look for us!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Guys... Guys... What if no one's coming... `Ever?`
nodes.text_bbcode: Guys... Guys... What if no one's coming... [color=#e23b3b][i]Ever?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What are you talking about?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Look outside! Do you see anyone? Any people walking around? Any cars driving? Do you even hear any birds chirping?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: N... No... What are you getting at?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I... I didn't want to bring up this possibility... But what if something happened outside? Something terrible? What if we're all that's left... Of the human race?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Why would we be all that's left?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Well... Remember, we are in a Faraday Cage. It blocks out all kinds of waves and radiations. Maybe it blocked out whatever happened out there?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Let me get this straight. You're saying. That there is a possibility. That the four of us are the last people on Earth.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: ...Yes?
Colt runs over and starts pounding on the door with his fists.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: `LET ME OUT OF HERE!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]LET ME OUT OF HERE![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: No! The Cage is the only thing keeping us safe!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: So what are we supposed to do?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: We'll have to accept it... Make the most of what we have... Begin a new society.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Oh no. Absolutely not. We are `not` making a new society!
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh no. Absolutely not. We are [color=#e23b3b][i]not[/i][/color] making a new society!

nodes.text: The four students move the desks around, setting up distinct areas...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: This here is the fashion/fitness zone, okay? It's for doing hair and working out!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: What do we care? Have you `seen` the Fortress of Awesometude that Colt and I set up over here? It's awesome!
nodes.text_bbcode: What do we care? Have you [color=#e23b3b][i]seen[/i][/color] the Fortress of Awesometude that Colt and I set up over here? It's awesome!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Ugggh.
A bunch of papers, pen, and pencils have been laid out on the ground. The four gather around them.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: And I say we name our new nation 'The Republic of Centerscore!'

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I like it!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I still prefer Coltopolis...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Now let's draw a flag!
The desks have all been laid out to split the room in half. Taylor and Colt sit on one side, Denni and Brendan on the other. They hurl spitballs back and forth!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Coltopolis will never bow to the Republic of Centerscore!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Oh, you will bow, dog... Or you will beg!
The desks have been rearranged to form a makeshift altar. Brendan and Taylor stand in front of it holding hands, while Denni stands behind them. Brendan stands to the side, whistling a wedding march.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Do you take this man, Brendan Berg, to be your lawful wedded husband?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I do!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Then as High Priestess of the Republic of Coltopolis, I pronounce thee man and wife! You may kiss the bride!
Brendan and Taylor kiss! Colt claps wildly!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Brings a tear to my eye... Oh, you crazy kids!
Well. Hmm. That's... Well, yeah, that's something.
We shouldn't have to tell you that this isn't the good ending!
Try again and see if you can get them out of that classroom!

args.text: Try again! We know you can do it!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Ahhhh!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Nooooooo!
Denni streaks down through the air...
And is caught in Colt's firm arms!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Oh!
Next to them, Taylor smashes into the ground with a resounding thud!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: `OWWWWWWW!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]OWWWWWWW![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: `My arm!` I really hurt my arm!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]My arm![/i][/color] I really hurt my arm!

nodes.text: Brendan runs over to Taylor!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Oh my gosh! Are you okay?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Do I look okay? Why didn't you catch me, Colt?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I was busy catching Denni!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: What about you, Brendan?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Things were moving too fast!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Speaking of catching... You're still holding me, Colt...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Oh! Right!
Colt puts Denni down. She runs over to Taylor and looks at her arm.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I don't think it's broken, but this is a pretty bad bruise...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: And we're still stuck here.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: We could... Try again?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Are you kidding? Did you see how unsafe that was? Someone could've gotten hurt!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I `did` get hurt!
nodes.text_bbcode: I [color=#3b78e2][i]did[/i][/color] get hurt!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: `I'm` definitely not going back up there...
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]I'm[/i][/color] definitely not going back up there...

nodes.text: All four look up at the vent. It hums, still firmly shut...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Great.
Six hours since lockdown.
The mood in the room has turned grim.
Brendan sits facing the corner, staring blankly at his dead cell phone. Colt cradles his head in his hands. Taylor lies at the far end of the room, holding her injured arm.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Sniffle... Sniffle... It... It still hurts...
Taylor sobs, short, shrill bleats...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Pssst! Princess! Can I have a word?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Um... Sure.
Denni steps to the far corner of the room with Colt.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Look, you need to do something about the waterworks over there.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Taylor? You mean, her crying?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I just... I can't sit here and listen to her cry anymore. I can't.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: What am I supposed to do? I don't even know her!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah, but you're a girl! You can, you know, girl-talk...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: The only way I know how to comfort a girl is by making out with her...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I can see how that would be a problem... I'll, um, I'll try my best.
Denni walks over to Taylor and hunkers down next to her.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Hey there, uh, girlfriend! You, um, doing okay?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: No, I'm not doing okay! My arm is broken!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Pretty sure it's not broken.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I saw this movie about the Middle Ages where this guy broke his arm, and they had to cut it off!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Pretty sure it's not the Middle Ages.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Oh, so I broke my arm, `and` I'm failing history! Wagggggh!
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh, so I broke my arm, [color=#3b78e2][i]and[/i][/color] I'm failing history! Wagggggh!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I need to motivate her to get past this! What should I talk about?

nodes.title: Trapped in the Classroom
nodes.subtitle: Denni is in for the worst detention of her life...

nodes.text: Friday afternoon. 2:35 p.m. With a deep sigh, Denni turns and steps through a door at the far end of the hallway...
And finds Colt sitting alone in a classroom, his head resting on the back of his chair!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Hey. Is this detention?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: No, tiny hipster. I'm just sitting alone in a classroom after school on a Friday because I like to learn.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Nice. I'll take that snippy sarcasm as a 'yes'.
Denni sits down at the opposite end of the room and begins laying out her books. Colt watches for a moment, then slides one seat closer.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: So... What'd you do to get sent here? Blast your low-fi indie rock a little too loud?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Har har. No, Principal Dyre sent me here because apparently my hair is a gross violation of the dress code.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I thought I'd get sent to Boot Camp, but I guess my GPA is too high...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Which does raise the question of why you're still here and not... You know, off breaking rocks by the side of the road or whatever.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: That's a prison gang, not Boot Camp!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: How would I know? I'm not a juvenile delinquent!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Says the girl in detention!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Only because...
The door to the room swings open. Brendan and Taylor walk in.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Oh, thank god. I was worried I'd be stuck here with Princess Punkhair. What are you two in for?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Protocol-45... Refusing To Stop Making References to a Long-Distance Relationship...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: And I apparently wore too much make-up... Since when was that even a rule?
Brendan and Taylor settle down.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: So, I've never really been in detention before. Is this going to hurt? Because I have a surprisingly low pain threshold...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Wow. As if it weren't bad enough that I have detention right before the basketball team's big away game, now I have to make smalltalk with a bunch of losers?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Hey!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Except for you. You're kind of cool.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Thanks!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Ugh... Kill me now...

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: Be careful what you wish for, young lady.
The four students spin around to find Principal Dyre standing at the back of the room!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Gah! How did you get there?!

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: I served my nation for seven years in the army. Unit: Special Forces. Operation: Highly classified.

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: But I'm not here to talk about me! No, I'm here to tell you about the `very special` detention that you're in for!
nodes.text_bbcode: But I'm not here to talk about me! No, I'm here to tell you about the [color=#e23b3b][i]very special[/i][/color] detention that you're in for!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I knew it! This `is` going to hurt! Please don't hit me with a ruler!
nodes.text_bbcode: I knew it! This [color=#e23b3b][i]is[/i][/color] going to hurt! Please don't hit me with a ruler!

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: Satisfying as it would be, I'm not going to hit you. After all, if you were hurt, you couldn't help test the Emergency Detention Lockdown System!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: The what?

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: You see, we've had a few incidents with detention security lately... Students sign in at the beginning, then slip out once the session's started!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I, uh, have no idea what you're talking about...

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: Today, that little practice ends. I've had the private contractors at Discipline Corp. install a state-of-the-art lockdown system in this very classroom!

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: And you... You lucky four get to be the first to try it out!

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: I'm going to step out of this room and press a little button... And then there'll be no way out unless `I` choose to let you out!
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm going to step out of this room and press a little button... And then there'll be no way out unless [color=#e23b3b][i]I[/i][/color] choose to let you out!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Principal Dyre, sir, with all due respect...

7:30 a.m. The next morning. Principal Dyre and Justin stand in the empty detention classroom. Dyre examines the hole in the floor with great interest.

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: Clever. Very, very clever. I must say, I'm impressed with these Centerscore deviants...

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: It took them less than 12 hours to find a way out of my Lockdown System!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Hold on, let me get this straight.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: You deliberately locked four students in here... Potentially overnight...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Just to see if they could find a flaw in your detention system?

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: Yes! Brilliant, isn't it?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Sir, with all due respect, I support a strict system of discipline... But don't you think that's a little excessive?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I mean, couldn't you get in a lot of trouble for this?
Principal Dyre stops in his tracks. He turns and looks at Justin closely.

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: Are you... Questioning my authority?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: No! Not at all, sir! I just...

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: Because if you `were` questioning my authority... Then I might have to prosecute you under Protocol-3!

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: Good! Don't let it!
Dyre turns and storms off. Justin kneels down and touches the hole in the floor...

nodes.text: Escaping through the floor, huh? Not bad at all.

He glances back at Boot Camp, where a lone siren is wailing... Then turns to the road ahead.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Centerscore High... I'm coming back...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: And I'm taking Principal Dyre `down!`
